full_judgment: 2. The petitioner-decree holder as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 60 of 1989 in the Court of the Assistant Judge Sherpur, Bogra impleading the opposite parties as defendants praying for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession after demolition of the homestead standing on the suit land measuring 1.76 acres of land appertaining to C.S. Khatian No.24113 corresponding to M.R.R. Khatian Nos. 202, 204, 215 and plot No. 75 of Mouza Sherun. The said suit was decreed on contest by the judgment and decree dated 6.2.93.
